messages:
incidents-bot: PAGER: sudden increase in 5xx and gateway timeouts for /v1/chat.complete (region: eu-central). Error rate 0.9% -> 14% in 4m. Paging oncall. :rotating_light:
Nora (oncall): I'm awake. seeing spikes in 502s and gateway timeouts. No obvious autoscaling events. @deploy-bot any recent config or deploys?
deploy-bot: deploy:service/router-api by samira at 2501234780. Change: kv_cache.max_entries=200k -> 25k; kv_cache.serial_version=3 -> 2.
Nora (oncall): that serial_version change might be risky. @Lee can you pull cache metrics and model pod logs?
Lee: pulling metrics. `grafana query prefix_cache.miss_ratio{region="eu-central"} | last 10m`
Lee: miss_ratio jumped to 32% post-deploy, eviction_rate spiked ~30x. Backend pod latency shows retries and some checksum errors in logs.
Samira: we reduced entries and changed serialization to save memory across nodes. Didn't expect such a hit. Rolling back now.
Nora (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) rollback config to previous values; 2) set route flag to skip prefix cache for chat.complete; 3) run integrity scan; 4) notify customers.
Samira: initiating rollback: applying kv_cache.max_entries=200k and serial_version=3.
Ops-Lead: notifying CS: possible degraded throughput and timeouts for advanced-generation workloads.
CustomerSuccess: we've queued a brief status message to affected customers and opened priority tickets for those who reported failures.
Lee: applied route bypass: `POST http://router.internal/flags {"route":"/v1/chat.complete","use_prefix_cache":false}`. Route now bypassing cache.
Lee: initial effect: p95 latency down from 2.8s -> 480ms for many requests. 5xx rate trending down to ~5% but still above baseline.
Nora (oncall): looking at pod logs: multiple lines like `ERROR kv_prefix: checksum mismatch, expected 0x9f8b got 0x3a2d, key=/models/gpt4x/prefix/zz99` — suggests serialized blob version mismatch or partial writes during shrink.
Lee: pulled sample logs from model-12:
```
{"time":2501234812,"pod":"model-12","level":"error","msg":"kv_prefix: checksum mismatch","key":"/models/gpt4x/prefix/zz99","attempts":1}
{"time":2501234813,"pod":"model-12","level":"warn","msg":"fetch fallback: miss","key":"/models/gpt4x/prefix/zz99"}
```
Samira: reduction of shard_count from 128 -> 16 plus aggressive compaction likely created collision and write interleaving; also serial_version downgrade created incompatibilities.
Nora (oncall): run integrity scanner: `kubectl exec -n infra kv-inspector -- python scan_prefixes.py --model gpt4x --out /tmp/scan-250123`
Lee: scan started. ETA 4m. Meanwhile enabling throttles on write path to reduce churn. `curl -X POST http://admin/controls -d '{"kv_write_rate": "throttle:500/s"}'`
Lee: scan results: ~0.05% prefixes with checksum or version mismatch, concentrated in shard range 10-14.
Nora (oncall): mitigation: mark affected keys as tombstoned and schedule lazy rebuild. Start kv-repair-job for shard range 10-14.
Samira: applying job: `kubectl apply -f jobs/kv_repair_shards_10-14.yaml`
Ops-Lead: prepare internal post for leadership: short cause, impact numbers, mitigation steps, ETA to full recovery.
CustomerSuccess: update sent to customers at 2501234920. No escalations yet, but two enterprise tenants reported intermittent timeouts earlier.
Lee: kv_repair job started, rehydration rate ~8k prefixes/s. Repaired ~40k keys so far. Memory/CPU within limits.
Nora (oncall): keep bypass in place for 30m after repairs complete. Watch metrics: prefix_cache.miss_ratio, eviction_rate, kv_checksum_errors, 5xx_rate.
Samira: rollback finished at 2501234955. kv_cache settings reverted and shard_count restored. checksum error logs reduced but not zero.
Lee: metrics update: 5xx down to 1.6% (from 14%). miss_ratio down to 3.9%. repair job at 64% complete.
Nora (oncall): run follow-up scan to ensure no lingering mismatches. If scan clean, plan to re-enable prefix cache gradually with a canary gate.
Samira: adding canary checks in deploy pipeline: abort if miss_ratio increases >5% within 2m of change or if checksum errors observed. Also removing serial version downgrades in fast rollouts.
Ops-Lead: please compile timeline and write a postmortem once stabilized. Include config diff and canary gating PR link.
Nora (oncall): handing off to @Samira for monitoring and post-rollback follow-through. Handoff notes:
- Root cause: aggressive cache size/shard reduction + serialization downgrade during deploy -> eviction storm + serialization incompatibilities -> checksum mismatches and elevated 5xx/timeouts
- Actions taken: rollback, route-level prefix cache bypass, kv integrity scan, targeted kv_repair job for affected shards, customer notifications, added deploy canaries
- Current status: repair 78% complete, 5xx 1.3%, monitoring for residual checksum logs
Samira: ack, I'll own until repair completes and one clean scan run. Will update channel on completion.
CustomerSuccess: monitoring customer tickets; no active escalations.
incidents-bot: NOTE: next oncall rotation at 2501236000.
Ops-Lead: postmortem required. Assign to eng-infra and eng-ml for follow-up. Include action items: serialization compatibility test, shard-reduction simulation, deploy gate.
Nora (oncall): closing active pager. Leaving channel open for questions. Thanks for fast responses. :heart:
Samira: updating status page: "Partial service degradation in eu-central resolved; monitoring continues."
incidents-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (pager cleared) 1: root cause assigned to eng-infra for follow-up.
